subject: Next steps: procurement path, payment options, and SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Adams <claire.adams@acmehealth.com>; Tom Ellis <t.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: procurement path and evidence asks (post-demo)

Hi Claire / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great to see how AcmeHealth is thinking about inference at scale. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can map to the right contracting path: 

- Procurement route: you mentioned preferring a PO with net-30. Can you confirm whether you want to do a one-time PO or a standing monthly PO commitment?
- Payment method: do you have any appetite to buy via AWS Marketplace (SaaS) instead of the paper PO? Marketplace buys can speed procurement but sometimes require a different billing/legal flow.
- Security/compliance: you said SOC 2 report + DPA are required. Can you confirm who on your side will be reviewing the DPA (legal or procurement)? Also want to confirm any additional evidence (pen-test, data residency) that matters for your procurement timeline.

Target from our side: I can loop in our security lead and our contracts manager to get SOC 2 excerpts and a DPA redline template ready by the end of the week. If you can share the procurement contact + target PO date that would be helpful.

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm PO vs Marketplace preference + procurement contact (Tom?)
2) We provide SOC 2 summary + DPA skeleton and a suggested procurement timeline
3) If PO chosen, our contracts team will share the redline and standard T&Cs for review

I attached a quick procurement worksheet to capture timelines and approvers (see "Procurement_MA_Timeline.xlsx" in thread).

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Procurement_MA_Timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Claire Adams <claire.adams@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement path and evidence asks (post-demo)

Thanks Ben — good demo, appreciate the follow-up. Some quick answers: 

- Procurement route: We prefer a PO (standing monthly PO) processed through our AP team. We try to avoid Marketplace unless there's a strong reason.
- PO details / contact: Tom Ellis (cc'd) is our procurement lead and will own the PO and terms. Targeting to have an approved PO in place by 2027-06-30.
- DPA review: Legal (Sarah Mills) will handle the DPA redline but procurement will coordinate.
- Security evidence: SOC 2 Type II report is required; a pen-test summary is helpful but not mandatory. Data residency: US only for now.

Tom — I'll let you jump in here for the PO process and any procurement-specific paperwork.

Thank you,
Claire Adams
Head of Data Products, AcmeHealth
claire.adams@acmehealth.com

Monica / Marissa / Neha — AcmeHealth prefers a standing monthly PO, target sign-off by 2027-06-30. Key asks from the customer: SOC 2 Type II report, DPA redline (Sarah Mills will review), and US data residency. Please see the attached procurement timeline I sent earlier. Can we: 

- Marissa: share our standard PO terms and a DPA skeleton for their legal team to start redlining

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-26T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement path, payment options, and SOC 2 evidence

Thanks for looping me in, Ben. Quick security plan below: 

- I attached a one-page SOC 2 summary (SOC2_summary_2024.pdf) that highlights scope, period, and controls. That should satisfy an initial procurement/legal review.
- DPA: I'll drop a DPA redline skeleton (DPA_redline_skeleton.docx) into the Drive link you provided so Sarah can annotate. Our standard positions are highlighted and we can be flexible on a handful of clauses (data subject rights, subprocessors).
- Pen-test: we have an executive summary we can share under NDA; procurement rarely needs the full report.
- Data residency: we confirm US-only processing for this account by default; if they need something stricter we can route to Private deployment options.

I'll upload the two artifacts to the shared Drive folder and add notes on expected turnaround times (SOC2 summary today, DPA skeleton within 24 hours).

Neha Kapoor
Security Operations, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachment: SOC2_summary_2024.pdf (PDF)
